This listing is the LOW-pressure lube oil pump, Ford F4TZ-6616-A, whose own description opens by saying it is not to be confused with the HPOP, and whose included list is a low-pressure pump and a seal. The listing is internally consistent and was left unchanged; the image does not belong on it. HPOPs are already sold separately as 2118 and 2129.

rejected-2119-alt.note: four injectors with pigtail harnesses and round plug connectors, a different injector family from the 7.3L HEUI unit already on this listing. The existing photograph matches the listing own part number AP63800AA and carries the characteristic yellow solenoid and stepped body of the 7.3L HEUI injector. Only one of the two can be the 7.3L part, so the existing photograph was kept and this file was not used.
